story_zh: 周末，我带着护照和行李箱去旅行。我坐飞机从北京起飞，到了南方的城市。酒店经理给我地图，告诉我附近有公园和黄河。我在街道上遇到新朋友，一起看世界著名的大楼。这个地方真美！
story_pinyin: Zhōumò, wǒ dàizhe hùzhào hé xínglǐxiāng qù lǚxíng. Wǒ zuò fēijī cóng Běijīng qǐfēi, dàole nánfāng de chéngshì. Jiǔdiàn jīnglǐ gěi wǒ dìtú, gàosù wǒ fùjìn yǒu gōngyuán hé Huáng Hé. Wǒ zài jiēdào shàng yùdào xīn péngyou, yīqǐ kàn shìjiè zhùmíng de dàlóu. Zhège dìfāng zhēn měi!
story_en: On the weekend, I took my passport and suitcase to travel. I flew from Beijing to a city in the south. The hotel manager gave me a map and told me there's a park and the Yellow River nearby. I met new friends on the street, and we saw world-famous buildings together. This place is so beautiful!
